tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Chalk. Page and app background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, search bar, filter chips at rest.

tokens.name: sandstone
tokens.usage: Map ground, dividers, progress-bar track, outlined-area fill under a 12% olive wash.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface and surface-raised; the ground bar in the mark on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, inactive tab icons. Passes 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Brand color. Primary buttons, active filter chip, visited map pins, progress fill, links.

tokens.name: on-olive
tokens.usage: Text and icons on olive.

tokens.name: sol
tokens.usage: Accent. The dot in the mark, follow-up pins, the Follow up button. Use sparingly: it always means someone to see.

tokens.name: on-sol
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sol. Never white on sol.

tokens.name: sol-tint
tokens.usage: Follow-up badge background, with ink text.

tokens.name: basalt
tokens.usage: Fixed dark brand ground: app icon, splash screen, greeting card on the map, merch. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-basalt
tokens.usage: Text and the ground bar of the mark on basalt.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and between stacked lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, gap between sections in a sheet.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet and card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between major blocks on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, contact rows, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, large panels, the app icon at 1x scale.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter chips. Pills echo the ground bar in the mark.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target, chips included.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary actions in the bottom sheet: big enough for one thumb, mid-walk.
